owner_decision:d1_oka_none.basis: No oka defined for ranked 段位戦 anywhere on tenhou.net/man (evidence.md GAP 1; sole occurrence is monthly-ranking glossary L935). Ranked consensus: no oka. Pre-authorized by Main before implementation.

owner_decision:d2_dead_wall_14.basis: Universal riichi standard 14-tile dead wall; page states only the 3-player count 「嶺上牌は8枚」 (L1098) for 4p replacement draws (evidence.md GAP 2). Pre-authorized.

owner_decision:d3_abortive_riichi_sticks.basis: Page states every abortive draw renchains 「すべて連荘」 (L1029) but never states stick disposition (evidence.md GAP 3). Deposited sticks remain deposited into the renchan hand per standard practice. Pre-authorized.

owner_decision:kuitan_ranked_allowed.basis: man.html L1016 lists 喰い断なし/あり選択 without fixing ranked tables; Main ruled ranked tables allow open tanyao (hub message, 2026-08-23).

secondary:tenhou_blog_38995838.note: Official Tenhou dev blog 「ウマの数値指定」: uma is parameterized per rank (2位/3位/4位 listed, ※１位は他順位から逆算) and settings where score does not reverse-compute ranks are excluded - establishes per-rank uma + zero-sum reverse-computation used to expand 10-20.
